description: This file defines the Secant class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, implementing functions for calculating the secant and hyperbolic secant of angles, including handling array inputs and exceptions.

classes.name: Secant
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate the secant and hyperbolic secant of angles, supporting scalar and array inputs.

methods.name: sec
methods.description: Calculates the secant of an angle, accepting either a single float or an array of floats.

methods.name: sech
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic secant of an angle, accepting either a single float or an array of floats.
